objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-enable-powershell-web-access
objects.description: The following analytic detects the enabling of PowerShell Web Access via PowerShell commands. It leverages PowerShell script block logging (EventCode 4104) to identify the execution of the `Install-WindowsFeature` cmdlet with the `WindowsPowerShellWebAccess` parameter. This activity is significant because enabling PowerShell Web Access can facilitate remote execution of PowerShell commands, potentially allowing an attacker to gain unauthorized access to systems and networks.
